numbering: Episodes numbered continuously across the 2004 series (1-366) and Thousand-Year Blood War (367 onward), as on Anime Filler Guide.

arcs.name: Agent of the Shinigami
arcs.summary: Teenager Ichigo Kurosaki, who can see ghosts, unexpectedly gains the powers of Soul Reaper Rukia Kuchiki and has to take over her job of protecting his town from Hollows.
events: Rukia Kuchiki transfers her powers to Ichigo to save his family from a Hollow.
Ichigo meets Quincy rival Uryū Ishida and the shopkeeper Kisuke Urahara.
Byakuya Kuchiki and Renji Abarai arrive, beat Ichigo, and take Rukia back to Soul Society for execution.

arcs.name: Soul Society: The Sneak Entry
arcs.summary: Ichigo trains to regain his powers and leads his friends into Soul Society to rescue Rukia.
events: Ichigo regains his Soul Reaper powers through Urahara's harsh training.
The group is fired into the Seireitei by Kūkaku Shiba's cannon.
Ichigo defeats Squad 11 captain Kenpachi Zaraki in a brutal duel.

arcs.name: Soul Society: The Rescue
arcs.summary: With Rukia's execution moved up, Ichigo masters Bankai in three days while the Gotei 13 turns on itself.
events: Ichigo achieves Bankai and defeats Byakuya at the execution site.
Captain Sōsuke Aizen is revealed to have faked his death and orchestrated everything.
Aizen, Gin Ichimaru and Kaname Tōsen defect to Hueco Mundo with the Hōgyoku.

arcs.name: The Bount
arcs.summary: Anime-original story about the Bount, life-energy-draining beings who target Karakura Town and later invade Soul Society.
events: Ichigo meets the Bount leader Jin Kariya and his followers.
The Bount break into Soul Society to take revenge on the Soul Reapers.
Ichigo defeats Kariya in their final battle.

arcs.name: Arrancar: The Arrival
arcs.summary: Aizen's Arrancar army starts attacking the human world while Ichigo struggles with the Hollow growing inside him.
events: Espada Grimmjow and Ulquiorra lead early raids on Karakura Town.
Ichigo trains with the Visored to control his inner Hollow.
Orihime Inoue is taken to Hueco Mundo by Ulquiorra.

arcs.name: Arrancar: Hueco Mundo Sneak Entry
arcs.summary: Ignoring orders, Ichigo, Uryū and Chad head into Hueco Mundo to rescue Orihime.
events: The group befriends former Espada Nel Tu.
Ichigo defeats Privaron Espada Dordoni.
Rukia and Chad face Espada Aaroniero and Nnoitra's subordinates.

arcs.name: Arrancar: The Fierce Fight
arcs.summary: The invaders split up and clash with the Espada inside Las Noches.
events: Ichigo defeats Grimmjow after a drawn-out duel.
Renji and Uryū beat Szayelaporro with Mayuri Kurotsuchi's help.
Captains arrive in Hueco Mundo as Aizen moves on Karakura Town.

arcs.name: The New Captain Shūsuke Amagai
arcs.summary: Anime-original story in which a new Squad 3 captain takes charge and Ichigo investigates the Kasumiōji noble clan.
events: Shūsuke Amagai becomes captain of Squad 3.
Ichigo protects the young Kasumiōji clan heiress.
Amagai's revenge plot against Central 46 is exposed.

arcs.name: Arrancar vs. Shinigami
arcs.summary: The battles in Las Noches reach their peak as Ichigo faces Ulquiorra.
events: Ichigo transforms into a full Hollow after being killed by Ulquiorra.
Kenpachi and Byakuya defeat Nnoitra and Zommari.
Ulquiorra disintegrates after his loss.

arcs.name: Turn Back the Pendulum
arcs.summary: A flashback set a century earlier, showing how the Visored came to be.
events: Urahara becomes captain of Squad 12 and founds the research institute.
Aizen's experiments Hollowfy Shinji Hirako and other officers.
Urahara and Tessai are exiled to the human world.

arcs.name: Decisive Battle of Karakura
arcs.summary: The Gotei 13 fights Aizen's top Espada in a fake Karakura Town.
events: Captain Commander Yamamoto traps Aizen's leaders in a ring of fire.
Captains battle Barragan, Starrk and Halibel.
The Visored join the fight against Aizen.

arcs.name: Zanpakutō Unknown Tales
arcs.summary: Anime-original story in which the Soul Reapers' swords take human form and rebel against their masters.
events: Muramasa frees the Zanpakutō spirits from their wielders' control.
Captains have to defeat their own swords.
Muramasa's master Kōga Kuchiki is revealed and beaten.

arcs.name: Arrancar: Downfall
arcs.summary: The war in Karakura Town comes to a head as Ichigo goes to face Aizen.
events: Ichigo learns the Final Getsuga Tenshō from Zangetsu.
Gin betrays Aizen and is killed.
Urahara's kidō seals Aizen as Ichigo loses his powers.

arcs.name: Gotei 13 Invading Army
arcs.summary: Anime-original story in which fake copies of Soul Reapers invade Karakura Town.
events: Reigai copies of the captains appear and attack.
Scientist Kagerōza Inaba is behind the copies.
Ichigo and Rukia stop Inaba's plan.

arcs.name: The Lost Agent
arcs.summary: Seventeen months later, powerless Ichigo is approached by Xcution, a group of Fullbringers who offer to help him recover.
events: Ichigo develops his Fullbring under Kūgo Ginjō.
Ginjō is revealed to be the first Substitute Shinigami and steals Ichigo's power.
The captains restore Ichigo's Soul Reaper powers and Ichigo defeats Ginjō.

arcs.name: Thousand-Year Blood War: The Blood Warfare
arcs.summary: The Wandenreich, a hidden Quincy empire led by Yhwach, declares war on Soul Society.
events: The Sternritter steal Bankai and devastate the Seireitei.
Captain Commander Yamamoto is killed by Yhwach.
Ichigo has his Bankai broken by Yhwach.

arcs.name: Thousand-Year Blood War: The Separation
arcs.summary: Soul Society regroups while Ichigo learns the truth about his origins.
events: Ichigo learns about his Quincy mother and reforges his Zanpakutō.
The Wandenreich replaces the Seireitei with its own city.
Uryū joins Yhwach's side as his successor.

arcs.name: Thousand-Year Blood War: The Conflict
arcs.summary: The Soul Reapers fight the remaining Sternritter as Yhwach heads for the Soul King's palace.
events: Kenpachi unlocks his Bankai and the Sternritter fall one by one.
Yhwach kills the Soul King and absorbs his power.
Aizen is freed to help fight Yhwach.

arcs.name: Thousand-Year Blood War: The Calamity
arcs.summary: The final cour, which follows the last battle against Yhwach (still airing as of October 2026).
events: Ichigo, Renji and the others confront Yhwach in the palace.
Uryū moves against Yhwach from within.
The anime departs further from the manga from episode 411.

filler.note: Filler comes from the Bount, Amagai, Zanpakutō and Reigai arcs and some standalone episodes; Thousand-Year Blood War (367 onward) has no filler.
